# google_agent_registry_agent

Represents a registered Agent in the Agent Registry.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.

## Example Usage - Agent Registry Agent Basic


```hcl
resource "google_agent_registry_agent" "example" {
  provider     = google-beta
  agent_id     = "default-agent"
  location     = "global"
  display_name = "My Agent"
  description  = "An agent registered in Agent Registry"

  interfaces {
    url              = "https://myagent.com"
    protocol_binding = "HTTP_JSON"
  }

  agent_spec {
    type    = "NO_SPEC"
  }
}
```

## Example Usage - Agent Registry Agent Full


```hcl
resource "google_agent_registry_agent" "example" {
  provider     = google-beta
  agent_id     = "full-agent"
  location     = "global"
  display_name = "My Agent"
  description  = "An agent registered in Agent Registry"

  agent_spec {
    type    = "A2A_AGENT_CARD"
    content = jsonencode({
      protocolVersion = "0.3"
      name            = "My Agent"
      description     = "An agent that does things"
      url         = "https://myagent.com"
      version     = "1.0.0"
      capabilities = {
        streaming = true
      }
      authentication = {
        schemes = ["Bearer"]
      }
      defaultInputModes  = ["text/plain"]
      defaultOutputModes = ["text/plain"]
      skills = [
        {
          id          = "do-things"
          name        = "Do Things"
          description = "Does various things"
          tags        = ["utility"]
        }
      ]
    })
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `agent_spec` -
  (Required)
  The specification of the Agent.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_agent_spec).

* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the Agent Registry service.

* `agent_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID to use for the agent service.


* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  User-defined display name for the Agent.

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  User-defined description of the Agent.

* `interfaces` -
  (Optional)
  The connection details for the Agent.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_interfaces).

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_agent_spec"></a>The `agent_spec` block supports:

* `type` -
  (Required)
  The type of the agent spec content.
  Possible values are: `TYPE_UNSPECIFIED`, `NO_SPEC`, `A2A_AGENT_CARD`.

* `content` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. The content of the Agent spec in JSON format.

<a name="nested_interfaces"></a>The `interfaces` block supports:

* `url` -
  (Required)
  The destination URL.

* `protocol_binding` -
  (Required)
  The transport protocol binding.
  Possible values are: `PROTOCOL_BINDING_UNSPECIFIED`, `JSONRPC`, `GRPC`, `HTTP_JSON`.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/services/{{agent_id}}`

* `name` -
  Output only. The resource name of the Agent.

* `registry_resource` -
  Output only. The resource name of the resulting Agent.

* `create_time` -
  Output only. The creation timestamp.

* `update_time` -
  Output only. The update timestamp.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


Agent can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/services/{{agent_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{agent_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{agent_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import Agent using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    agentId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_agent_registry_agent.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import Agent using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/services/{{agent_id}}"
  to = google_agent_registry_agent.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), Agent can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_agent_registry_agent.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/services/{{agent_id}}
$ terraform import google_agent_registry_agent.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{agent_id}}
$ terraform import google_agent_registry_agent.default {{location}}/{{agent_id}}
```
